title: Intersection of [0, 1 + 1/n] is [0, 1]
caption: Every interval [0, 1 + 1/n] contains [0, 1], and any x > 1 is excluded once 1 + 1/n < x, so the intersection is exactly [0, 1]. The union of [1/n, 2] is (0, 2]: every positive x up to 2 gets in, but 0 never does.
alt: A number line from −1 to 3 with the half-open interval (0, 2] for the union and the closed interval [0, 1] for the intersection.
description: The intervals [1/n, 2] grow towards 0 as n increases but never reach it.
So the union is (0, 2]: 0 excluded, 2 included.
The intervals [0, 1 + 1/n] shrink towards 1 from above.
